title: A long cloud session picks up hook changes from main, not only the copy it installed at start
why: A stale guard copy lets mistakes through that main's guard refuses.
note: Coordinator 13:00 CST Nov 11: a long cloud session runs the hooks it installed at start. The coordinator ran a guard copy older than 10e38b0ae (lane start: effort field and brief as prompt) until 12:50 CST today, so 7 lane starts sent a bare "/effort medium" prompt and the lane-effort-pin guard never saw them (retrospective brief audit, 12:56 CST). The guard that would have stopped it is lane-effort-pin, which was not loaded. Owner 12:59 CST (relayed by the retrospective): "its weird a lane can be spawned without its brief first preprovided like somesthings going wrong if the lane/session just autospawns and then gets filled in after the fact, feels weird". Plan 691a84e places this as stage 3 item 3.10.
